summary: The Agent–Computer Interface specializes narrow interfaces at the action boundary and emits structured events for trace and recovery.

items.text: Narrow Interfaces supplies the general design rule; this pattern adds agent-facing schemas, effects, retry semantics and evidence.
Treat every returned observation as provenance-carrying data, even when the tool itself is trusted.
Declare capabilities in the contract and let Sandbox enforce the actual operating-system, filesystem and network rights.
Keep permission grants outside the descriptive interface: Agent Fencing decides which contracted operations this actor may invoke for this task.
Process Actor owns claims, leases and lifecycle verdicts across calls; a tool contract governs one action and its result.
Emit operation identity, contract version, request, result, side effects and evidence pointers into the run trace.
